title: kbmon's querylog panel counts a distilled prompt's usage twice: spool row and store sidecar
goal: the querylog panel's usage of today counts each prompt once, whether its usage sits in the spool, in the local store's usage sidecars or in both, and usage.md and monitoring.md say how the two are matched

run:
import os,tempfile,sys,json,datetime,uuid
T=tempfile.mkdtemp();os.environ.update(CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=T,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=os.getcwd())
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_base,ql_report,ql_store,kbusage
q,_=ql_base.places();(q/'spool').mkdir(parents=True)
ts=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
u={'main':{'claude-sonnet-5-5':{'requests':1,'in':100,'cw':0,'cw1h':0,'cr':0,'out':50}},'start':0}
a=str(uuid.uuid4())
R=lambda s,**k:json.dumps({'id':str(uuid.uuid4()),'ts':ts.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'),'surface':s,'v':1,'session_id':'s','prompt_id':'p',**k})
(q/'spool'/'s.jsonl').write_text(R('prompt',prompt='x')+'\n'+R('usage',reader=kbusage.READER_VERSION,usage=u)+'\n')
ql_store.write_usage(q/'store',ts.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')+'-abcdef01',[ql_store.usage_line(a,u)],0,kbusage.READER_VERSION)
r=ql_report.usage_today(q);print(r['rows']);sys.exit(0 if r['rows']==1 else 1)

notes: SP-v4yih547 review: usage_today matches sidecar ids against spool prompt_ids, but a sidecar id is an entry id, so the dedupe never matches; spool rows stay until delivery, so a distilled prompt counts twice. The review changed ST-go6vdmnt g2 to this fix. Check 0 of ST-go6vdmnt only type-checked usage.
